title.en: The index of the maximum of a sequence

description.zh:
最大值索引：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

輸入以 0 結束的題目不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；需要小數結果時使用 double。
description.en:
A sequence consists of integer numbers and ends with the number 0. Determine the index of the largest element of the sequence. If the highest element is not unique, print the index of the first of them.

C++ note: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.

hint.zh: 輸入以 0 結束的題目不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；需要小數結果時使用 double。
hint.en: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.
